reading: The sketch lays out a Google-Sheets-style page: a top app bar with a logo, title and menu, a toolbar pill of formatting icons, a formula/name bar, a column-header row, a left page-number rail, a large data grid of sales figures, and a bottom sheet-tabs bar pinned to the page bottom.
